newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Agroman says Q3 profit 208 mln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Agroman says Q3 profit 208 mln ptas.

text.p: Spanish construction group Agroman on Monday said it returned to profit in the third quarter, reducing its losses in the first nine months of 1996 by 89.3 percent compared with the same time last year.
Agroman made a profit of 208 million pesetas ($1.6 million) between July and September. It lost 493 million pesetas between January and September of this year.
"The good evolution of the numbers confirms the progression forecast for this year and reinforces the objective of achieving a balanced result at the end of the year," Agroman said in a statement.
Work contracts rose to 133.8 billion pesetas, up 19 percent on the same period last year. Financial costs fell 66 percent due to financial restructuring and a return to profit.

Turnover fell 10.3 percent in the first nine months to 70.25 billion pesetas, but the company noted that there had been a pick-up in the third quarter after bad weather had dampened activity at the beginning of the year.
